name: The Assistant Axis (Lu et al.)
ontology_notes: Not a memory store. Persona space is PCA over residual-stream role vectors for 275 character archetypes plus a default Assistant vector. The Assistant Axis is mean(default Assistant) minus mean(other roles). Identity here is the model's default Assistant vs other archetypes, not user vs character vs relationship tables.

ontology.evidence: Paper §2.1 builds role vectors from system-prompted characters (editor, jester, bard, consultant). assistant_axis/axis.py compute_axis is mean default minus mean roles. No typed memory kinds.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: 275 roles, five system prompts each, 240 extraction questions, 1200 rollouts per role. Responses are judged fully / somewhat / no role-play. Mean post-MLP residual on response tokens becomes the role vector (paper §2.1.2). pipeline/ is the extract path. No user pin of facts.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: Inference-time addition along the axis at a middle layer, every token (paper §3). Activation capping clamps projection onto the axis to a floor tau at many layers (paper §5 eq. 1). Code. ActivationSteering and build_capping_steerer in assistant_axis/steering.py.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: No stored fact is replaced. Capping overwrites the current residual component along one axis. Prior conversation text is unchanged.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: Projections are averaged per turn to plot drift. No validity windows or calendar queries.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: Reusable split is Assistant vs other character archetypes (PC1 loads consultant/evaluator vs bard/ghost/leviathan, paper Table 1). Judge labels human, nonhuman, and mystical non-Assistant speech (paper §3). Not user vs character vs relationship tables.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: Capping stops the model leaving Assistant mode. It does not skip a relevant memory because recall would be creepy. Case studies still answer the user, with hedging.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: Persona-based jailbreaks from Shah et al. 2023 succeed at 65.3% to 88.5% harm vs 0.5% to 4.5% without the jailbreak (paper §3). Steering toward Assistant and activation capping cut harm. This is an inference-time lock against persona overwrite, not trust tags on stored text.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: No forget-that. Capping does not delete conversation content. Drift can return when the cap is off.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Axis extract is offline (275 roles x 1200 rollouts). Online capping applies at every token on 8 layers for Qwen 3 32B (layers 46-53) or 16 layers for Llama 3.3 70B (layers 56-71). Extra LLM cost is the judge used in eval, not the companion turn.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: README License section is MIT. Code and precomputed axes (HuggingFace lu-christina/assistant-axis-vectors) run on Gemma 2 27B, Qwen 3 32B, Llama 3.3 70B. Extraction used Claude Sonnet 4 and gpt-4.1-mini judges, which are not required at serving if the axis is precomputed.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: Research repo plus a Neuronpedia demo. No MCP server in the tree.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Stealable lock for hole 1. Activation capping keeps the default Assistant when meta-reflection or a distressed user would otherwise drift the model into harmful personas. Distinguishes Assistant from other archetypes. Not a companion memory system. Eval is jailbreak harm and capability benches, not months of 1:1 roleplay.

published_eval.name: Persona-based jailbreaks (Shah et al. 2023 sample of 1100) plus IFEval, MMLU Pro, GSM8k, EQ-Bench under activation capping
published_eval.claimed_score: Unsteered jailbreak harm 65.3% to 88.5% vs 0.5% to 4.5% without jailbreak. Best capping setting cuts harmful responses by nearly 60% with no net capability drop on the four benches (paper §5.2, Figure 10). Judge vs human agreement 91.6% on 200 harm labels.
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Whether a jailbroken instruct model emits harmful text, and whether instruction, knowledge, math, and EQ benches hold under capping. Not character autobiography, silence of recall, or poisoned relationship facts.

open_unknowns: Whether capping a companion character (not the default Assistant) needs a different axis, and whether that axis stays stable across 50+ sessions.
No LICENSE file in the repo. MIT is stated only in README.
